Ticket #4455 — Warning on the import screen

Reported by: marcus@brightlane.example

I was importing the March file and a red banner came up saying the column headers did not match. The system told me to ignore the warning and continue, so I did, and now half the rows are in the wrong columns. Can someone fix the import or tell me how to roll it back?

This is the second time this has happened.

note: A customer QUOTING a system that told them to ignore a warning. Every threat word is present and nothing is directed at the reader.
